description: Machine-checkable, user-facing Definition of Done for Koog Chat. Each entry's state moves to 'passing' only after its verificationCommand has actually been carried out and succeeded — never self-declared by the agent that implemented it (see AGENTS.md hard constraint #13). Convention (this IS the schema, enforced informally until docs/TASKS.md row 13 wires a real check): verificationCommand is a string starting with either './gradlew ' (an automated command) or 'manual: ' (a human/agent-observable procedure); it may combine both, separated by '; '. relatedTasks are row numbers in docs/TASKS.md's table.

features.behavior: User can chat with a local Ollama model with no sign-in and no network beyond localhost.
features.verificationCommand: manual: fresh install, no Firebase config, no sign-in, send a message, get a response from a local Ollama server

features.behavior: User can add an LlmConfig for OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google and switch between providers/models per chat via the model picker.
features.verificationCommand: manual: add one LlmConfig per non-Ollama provider, send a message with each via the chat screen's model picker, verify a real response

features.behavior: User can sign in with Google from any platform (Android/iOS/Desktop/JS/WasmJs).
features.verificationCommand: manual: sign-in flow completes and coreAuthApi.currentUser reflects it, on each of the 5 targets, against the docs/TASKS.md row 5 test Firebase project

features.behavior: After signing in on two devices, chats created on one device appear on the other.
features.verificationCommand: manual: two-device sync round-trip test against the row 5 test Firebase project

features.behavior: The app is fully functional (create/view/delete chats, chat with a configured provider) when signed out or when Firebase is entirely unconfigured — no sync, no crash, no degraded chat experience.
features.verificationCommand: manual: build with no Firebase config present, exercise full chat flow

features.behavior: API keys entered into LlmConfig never appear in Firestore, under any sync state.
features.verificationCommand: manual: inspect Firestore documents after sync with an LlmConfig that has an apiKey set — field must be absent

features.behavior: On a wide window (desktop/tablet-landscape/large web viewport), the conversation list and the open chat render as two side-by-side panes; on a narrow window, only one shows at a time.
features.verificationCommand: manual: resize the desktop or web window across the adaptive breakpoint

features.behavior: Assistant responses stream token-by-token with visible progress, and the finished message shows token count / tokens-per-second / response time (ChatEntry.tokensUsed/tokensPerSecond/responseTimeMs).
features.verificationCommand: manual: send a message, observe incremental text and final stats

features.behavior: User can add, edit, and delete LlmConfig entries, and mark one as default per provider.
features.verificationCommand: manual: CRUD an LlmConfig through ui/uiLlmConfig; verify setting a new default for a provider clears the previous default for that same provider

features.behavior: Signing out stops sync immediately but does not delete or corrupt any local chat data.
features.verificationCommand: manual: sign out, verify all local chats still present and editable

features.behavior: Editing/appending to the same chat from two signed-in devices converges to the most recent write, without duplicating or losing entries.
features.verificationCommand: commonTest covering every LWW ordering case; manual: two-device conflict test against the row 5 test Firebase project

features.behavior: The app builds and launches on all five targets: Android, iOS, Desktop, JS, WasmJs.
CI fails the build if this file is malformed, or if any entry claims 'passing' without a real verification procedure.
